why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Stage and commit' (passes: the repository has one commit and it adds pancakes.md). The learner pasted the command with curly quotes, `git commit -m “Add pancake recipe”`. zsh doesn't treat “ ” as quotes, so git got -m “Add and two pathspecs: 'error: pathspec 'pancake' did not match any file(s) known to git'. Nothing was committed; `git log --oneline` says the branch has no commits yet. The command and pancakes.md are on screen, but there is no commit.

step.title: Commit pancakes.md
step.instructions: In the cookbook folder, run git commit -m "Add pancake recipe" to save the staged pancakes.md as your first commit, then git log --oneline to see it.

targets.caption: Save the staged file as a commit

files.cookbook/pancakes.md:
# Pancakes

- 1 cup flour
- 1 cup milk
- 1 egg

Terminal: tripi@mac cookbook % git commit -m “Add pancake recipe”
error: pathspec 'pancake' did not match any file(s) known to git
error: pathspec 'recipe”' did not match any file(s) known to git
fatal: your current branch 'main' does not have any commits yet
